findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Unsafe code execution via eval/exec
 * @description Detects use of eval, exec, or similar dangerous functions
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/code-execution
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-094
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::builtin(["eval", "exec", "compile"]).getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember("system").getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("subprocess").getMember(["call", "run", "Popen", "check_call", "check_output"]).getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("pickle").getMember(["load", "loads", "Unpickler"]).getACall()
select call, "Potentially unsafe code execution or deserialization operation."
findings.hypothesis: Check for unsafe code execution via eval, exec, or similar functions that could be exploited

message.text: Potentially unsafe code execution or deserialization operation.
Potentially unsafe code execution or deserialization operation.

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Unsafe code execution in markdown processing
 * @description Using eval, exec, or similar functions with untrusted markdown content
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/code-execution-markdown
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-094
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::builtin("eval").getACall() or
  call = API::builtin("exec").getACall() or
  call = API::builtin("execfile").getACall() or
  call = API::builtin("compile").getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember("system").getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("subprocess").getMember(["call", "check_call", "check_output", "run", "Popen"]).getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("pickle").getMember(["load", "loads", "Unpickler"]).getACall()
select call, "Potentially unsafe code execution or deserialization operation."
findings.hypothesis: Unsafe code execution or deserialization operations in markdown processing code
